name: Imp Midna
description: (Tag:dark)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:teleporter)(Character)Imp Midna is the Twilight Princess suppressed into Imp form yet retaining potent magic including basic telekinesis, shapeshifting, cloud form, shadow merging, and time-consuming Twilight Portals for teleportation. A Legendary curse-breaking ability can restore her full form and drastically enhance her powers.
